purpose: ExtraMarkups is a 3D Slicer extension that provides custom markups node types ('Label' for arrows and text labels and 'Shape' for primitive 3D shapes/parametric shapes) integrated into Slicer's Markups framework.
summary: ExtraMarkups is a well-structured C++ 3D Slicer extension providing two custom markups types ('Label' and 'Shape'). The source code is clean, relies entirely on standard Slicer/VTK C++ APIs, contains no Python scripts or external package installations, includes clear CeCILL-B licensing terms, and correctly hooks into Slicer's CMake build system and Markups framework. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected all C++ source files and CMake build files. No network calls, no telemetry, no unsafe code execution (eval/exec/popen), no arbitrary file deletion, and no unauthorized environment changes.

environment.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt and C++ source files; no Python code, no shared environment modifications, package installations, or side-effects at import time.

packaging.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt and module subdirectories. The CMake files correctly use Slicer macros (slicerMacroBuildLoadableModule, SlicerMacroBuildModuleMRML, SlicerMacroBuildModuleLogic, SlicerMacroBuildModuleWidgets) to build and export all compiled modules and widget libraries.

license.rationale: The extension includes LICENSE.txt which contains the full text of the CeCILL-B Free Software License Agreement (BSD-style), and README.md explicitly references CeCILL-B, granting broad rights for open-source distribution.

soundness.rationale: Follows 3D Slicer C++ loadable module and custom markups node/widget/logic conventions, subclassing vtkMRMLMarkupsNode, vtkSlicerMarkupsLogic, etc., properly.

utility.rationale: Provides clear documentation in README.md and module descriptions, detailing the purpose of the Label and Shape custom markups nodes.

not_checked: Full compilation of C++ source code in Slicer environment (requires local Slicer superbuild / build environment)
